curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Crayon-on-rough-paper charm, low and loose. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its place big and short, while Tsukimi Rounded, a sans-serif with round parenthesis-like forms, isn't built for lengthy paragraphs.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-noto-nas: Jersey 10 Charted is tightly drawn and snugly spaced, all display swagger. Noto Nastaliq Urdu keeps a tight vertical rhythm with little ascender height, dignified and best kept to brief text.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose, leaning handwriting, letters nearly touching. Kapakana is best at closed, casual display lines, while Spectral SC, a serif with sturdy hairlines, handles a few short lines with wide-mouthed round forms.
